title: Two identical platforms, two and four storeys, at their own drafts

provenance.basis: Illustrative archetype for projects/floating-city-design-challenge (scenario SCN_FLOATCITY_COASTAL_01); not an engineering design. Drafts are the analysis values of two platforms floating independently (revisions.B_neighbours_2_vs_4_storeys): the decks differ by 0.664 m. It does not show what a rigid link would do.
